commit.message:
refactor: rebrand move -> greatlee (marketplace, plugin, dir)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

files.patch:
@@ -1,10 +1,10 @@
 {
-  "name": "move",
-  "owner": { "name": "move" },
+  "name": "greatlee",
+  "owner": { "name": "greatlee" },
   "plugins": [
     {
-      "name": "house-standard",
-      "source": "./move-house-standard",
+      "name": "greatlee-standard",
+      "source": "./greatlee-standard",
       "description": "Stamp house-standard guardrails into a new project via /init"
     }
   ]

@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ SCAFFOLD=""
 if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scaffold/scaffold.mjs" ]; then
   SCAFFOLD="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scaffold/scaffold.mjs"
 else
-  SCAFFOLD="$(find "$HOME/.claude" "$HOME/.config/claude" -type f -path '*house-standard/scaffold/scaffold.mjs' 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
+  SCAFFOLD="$(find "$HOME/.claude" "$HOME/.config/claude" -type f -path '*-standard/scaffold/scaffold.mjs' 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
 fi
 echo "engine: ${SCAFFOLD:-NOT FOUND}"
 SETUP="$(dirname "$SCAFFOLD")/setup.mjs"
